tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find library print books and ebooks by title, author, or subject.

tools.name: get_loan_details
tools.description: Look up the due date and renewal eligibility for one book already borrowed on your library account.

tools.name: extend_loan
tools.description: Renew a current library loan and return its new due date.

tools.name: place_hold
tools.description: Join the library waiting list for a book and choose a pickup branch.

tools.name: cancel_hold
tools.description: Cancel a waiting-list request that you previously placed.

tools.name: list_branch_hours
tools.description: Read staffed opening and closing times for a library branch.

tools.name: find_public_computers
tools.description: See available public computer seats by library branch and time.

tools.name: list_member_fees
tools.description: Read outstanding fines and service charges on the member account.
